# Stranded Branch Finder

> Finds git commits pushed to a remote that are in no pull request and not on the main branch, using only git. A zero-dependency Python script plus a paste-in browser check. Free, MIT.

Results report what git shows; a listed branch may be parked on purpose. Not legal, financial or professional advice.
